en_title: NBA 2K27 Is Adding Vice City, GTA 6-Themed Cosmetics, and Much More as Part of Massive Rockstar Games Collaboration
cn_title: 《NBA 2K27》将推出罪恶都市、《GTA6》主题外观物品及更多内容，作为与Rockstar大规模合作的一部分
opus_summary: 《NBA 2K27》第三赛季将于11月27日推出，以《GTA6》为主题，加入罪恶都市场景、主题装饰和游戏物品。赛季持续七周，GTA+订阅用户可于11月27日至1月15日免费游玩《NBA 2K27》；在XBOX和PlayStation预购《GTA6》可获一个月GTA+免费试用。

paragraphs.en: Vice City is coming to NBA 2K27 as part of a massive crossover with GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 作为与《GTA6》大规模联动的一部分，罪恶都市即将登陆《NBA 2K27》。

paragraphs.en: NBA 2K27's Season 3 update will arrive on November 27, and it's completely focused on GTA 6. The new update will take players to Vice City via a new park next to the city's park. The area features oddles of GTA imagery, including the Vice City blimp that has been flying around Miami in real life and a statue of Macca the Gator, a cartoon character in GTA 6 . Additionally, the season's rewards pass will also give you access to a wide variety of GTA-themed cosmetics and items, including new takeover abilities inspired by the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《NBA 2K27》第3赛季更新将于11月27日推出，内容完全围绕《GTA6》展开。此次更新将通过城市公园旁的一座新球场，把玩家带到罪恶都市。该区域有大量《GTA》相关元素，包括现实中一直在迈阿密上空飞行的罪恶都市飞艇，以及《GTA6》中的卡通角色Macca the Gator的雕像。此外，本赛季的奖励通行证还将让你获得种类繁多的《GTA》主题外观物品和道具，包括受该游戏启发而设计的新接管能力。

paragraphs.en: As one might imagine, fans will also be able to rep the new Miami Heat jerseys that were created in collaboration with Rockstar Games. On November 18, the Miami Heat will play a real, regular-season NBA game as the Vice City Heat , complete with new jerseys and a never-before-seen court. It should be quite the spectacle, and one that you will be able to at least partially recreate in-game.
paragraphs.cn: 正如人们可能想到的那样，粉丝们还可以穿上迈阿密热火队与Rockstar合作打造的新球衣。11月18日，迈阿密热火队将在一场真实的NBA常规赛中以罪恶都市热火队的身份出战，届时会穿上新球衣，并使用一个从未亮相过的球场。这应该会是一场相当壮观的比赛，而你至少可以在游戏中部分重现这一场景。

paragraphs.en: Season 3 will last for seven weeks, and players can actually get in on the action without buying NBA 2K27. If you subscribe to Rockstar's subscription service, GTA+, you will be able to play NBA 2K27 for free from November 27 to January 15. Anyone who pre-orders GTA 6 on Xbox and PlayStation is entitled to a free one-month trial of GTA+, so this would be a great way to put it to use. Starting December 17, subscribers will also be able to take advantage of free GTA-themed items and bonuses in NBA 2K27. Ultimately, it seems like NBA 2K27 doesn't have to worry about fans deleting their games in the same way Madden does .
paragraphs.cn: 第3赛季将持续七周，而玩家其实无需购买《NBA 2K27》就能参与其中。如果你订阅了Rockstar的订阅服务GTA+，就可以在11月27日至1月15日期间免费游玩《NBA 2K27》。在XBOX和PlayStation上预购《GTA6》的玩家都可以获得一个月的GTA+免费试用，因此这会是利用该试用资格的好方法。从12月17日起，订阅用户还可以在《NBA 2K27》中获得免费的《GTA》主题道具和奖励。归根结底，看来《NBA 2K27》不必像《Madden》那样担心粉丝删除游戏。

paragraphs.en: This update was teased earlier this fall when NBA 2K27 was released , but 2K and Rockstar Games kept a tight lid on what would actually be featured in the update. It appears that this is one of the final marketing beats for GTA 6, as the game will officially release this week. (I know, it's as crazy for me to write as it is for you to read.) The game will have a regional rollout, meaning that folks in New Zealand will technically start playing it a day before users in the United States (unless you take advantage of some loopholes).
paragraphs.cn: 今年秋季早些时候，《NBA 2K27》发售时曾预告过这次更新，但2K和Rockstar对更新中实际包含的内容一直严加保密。这似乎是《GTA6》最后几项营销活动之一，因为游戏将于本周正式发售。（我知道，我写下这句话和你读到它一样觉得不可思议。）游戏将按地区分批发售，这意味着从技术上讲，新西兰玩家会比美国用户早一天开始游玩（除非你利用一些漏洞）。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is available to pre-load right now , and Rockstar has already pushed out a couple of updates , which fans will need to download before they play the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》现已开放预载，Rockstar也已经推送了几项更新，粉丝需要在游玩前下载这些更新。
